node_id.description: The node_id of a node of this package.

proxy.description: Where the image's low-resolution preview is.

is.description: Which bytes are the preview. One of: `original` (the image's own bytes ARE the preview: the linked file had not been read when the document was saved); `pixels` (the bytes of the image's pixels node); `node` (the payload of the node named by `node`).

description: What VectorCraft keeps of some images beside what the structure node says: the low-resolution preview a linked image shows while its file cannot be read, and the bytes of images in an encoding VectorCraft did not recognise.

key.description: The image key (as in the structure node's `images` table and in image objects).

mime.description: With `original`: the media type VectorCraft holds for those bytes.

original.description: The x.vectorcraft.source.other node with the image's own bytes, in an encoding VectorCraft did not recognise.

proxy.description: The image's preview. Absent: it has none.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema: 1.

title: x.vectorcraft.embedded - previews of linked images, and images in unrecognised encodings
